Joy is no emotion or state,
but the sonorous motion of essence, and its boundless estate.
Joy is at peace in the splendour of timeless Being.
And in Being's Time, it's playful and perplexing love and Becoming,
Joy is the valiant mission and fairest muse.
If you know Joy's indestructibility you will shine,
and there will be no night to warrant thieves.
